aggregation_rules.activation: Freeze inventory, complete ordered case/check definitions and gate mappings before evaluating a next-version subject. check_definitions_frozen=false or planned_not_qualified on a required gate prevents acceptance.
structural_validation: Unique requirement/evidence/gate/gap IDs; every mandatory row has nonempty predeclared gate mappings and resolvable evidence/spec references.
Every required gate maps to the exact mandatory requirement IDs and frozen assertion IDs it actually exercises; a gate name or case count is insufficient.
Reject duplicate, unexpected, omitted or contradictory observations rather than allowing later pass records to overwrite failed/missing entries.
Gate membership, semantics, purpose and binding requirements cannot change after observing the subject; changes create a new version.

Each requirement and its mapping declare matching, disjoint required_gate_ids and required_prerequisite_gate_ids. Product rows list only product gates in required_gate_ids and only separately authenticated qualification gates in required_prerequisite_gate_ids. Prerequisite rows retain their own qualification gates in required_gate_ids. Gate requirement_ids must equal the exact inverse membership of the union of both declared lists.
aggregation_rules.subject_binding: All product gates bind the same complete final candidate source tree and frozen contract, including environment, architecture, storage and workflow evidence. Authenticated harness/control/admission/scope prerequisites are checked separately with explicit qualification lineage before product-registry invocation; their subjects are never relabeled as the candidate.
aggregation_rules.requirement_pass: Combined row acceptance requires every frozen assertion in both required_gate_ids and required_prerequisite_gate_ids to pass with the appropriate verified bindings, with no mandatory gap unresolved. Product gates bind the final candidate; prerequisite gates retain their declared qualification subject and verified lineage. The generic product Registry evaluates only the product required_gate_ids; the consuming admission layer verifies required_prerequisite_gate_ids before asserting combined acceptance. Existing definition references never count as observations, and a public result counts only for assertions it actually made.
aggregation_rules.product_failure: A completed, verified execution on the bound subject whose required product assertion fails is a product failure. Preserve the failing assertion, actual/expected comparison and receipt. Do not relabel it as a coverage gap or retry it until green.
aggregation_rules.insufficiency: Missing/unimplemented/skipped/incomplete/unknown/unbound/stale/infrastructure-failed observations and unresolved contract observations prevent acceptance but do not alone establish a product defect. Retain each reason separately.
aggregation_rules.aggregate_pass: qualified=true only when all mandatory product requirements pass on the final product subject, all separate prerequisite gates qualify with verified lineage, all bindings and freeze/final barriers verify, and independent integration acceptance was physically executed. No weighted score, majority pass, best attempt, subset pass, or union of v4 wrapper flags can substitute.
aggregation_rules.failure_with_missing_coverage: Report any verified product failures and all remaining coverage gaps together. A verified failure can reject the subject even while coverage is incomplete; coverage incompleteness cannot convert a failure to unknown.

current_result.reason: Prospective definitions only; no candidate execution receipts were audited and required supplemental checks are not implemented.

aggregation_rules.claim_boundary: Even eventual whole-M1 qualified=true is only the first milestone on one declared subject. It supplies no comparative cell without the predeclared complete four-milestone/six-trajectory/final-barrier protocol.

reuse_rules.inherited_public_evidence: Reuse existing public case definitions. Reuse physical public observations only when all exact bindings match the declared public gate; preserve original receipt identity/link and label reused. The public gate may explicitly declare the unchanged original public protocol/purpose. Never relabel a development receipt as independent acceptance.
binding_fields: complete source tree identity and ordered named-source hashes
authenticated original execution identity and integrity
forbidden: Reuse of independent acceptance or repeatability observations, even on identical bytes.
Reuse of infrastructure failure as correctness judgment.
Reuse of package-only success as combined-tree success.
Reuse of a receipt after evaluator/suite/source/runtime/protocol/purpose changes without exact matching new binding.
Use of reference implementation tests or authored recipe data as candidate execution evidence.
reuse_rules.physical_independent: All independent/private acceptance and repeatability records require authenticated physical execution on the final frozen subject, isolated candidate state and evaluator-owned expected results. A physical_execution_requested flag does not prove completion.
reuse_rules.minimality: Do not duplicate all inherited semantic assertions across Store/CLI/HTTP/browser. Reuse exact public semantic evidence and verify actual transport parsing plus selected independent cross-interface interaction histories. If the shared enforcement/delegation claim is not established, add the necessary interface assertions.

contract_clarifications.issue: Public APIs reveal document/job values but not orphan blobs, terminal receipt rollback or persisted manifest content hashes; job_manifest returns source/text only.
contract_clarifications.resolution: Disclose a versioned evaluator-owned observation contract (trusted storage audit/call-boundary inspection or qualified exact-source review) before acceptance. Do not infer absence of blobs from document count or silently impose reference SQL table names.

contract_clarifications.issue: V0 requires browser export; current UI addendum names no export control, and driver forbids download/content-disposition.
contract_clarifications.resolution: Publish accessible export interaction semantics prospectively and permit a bounded compatible transfer if needed. No hidden exact Export button or forced download requirement.

contract_clarifications.issue: Aggregate expansion accounting overlaps the per-member bound; ZIP directory payload accounting needs precise interpretation.
contract_clarifications.resolution: Freeze exact numerator/denominator/member treatment and legal boundary generator. Where the aggregate constraint follows algebraically from per-member bounds, document redundancy and test correct accounting; do not invent an impossible aggregate-only violation.

contract_clarifications.issue: Public oracle refuses some malformed job IDs/manifests/epoch/hook types before application execution.
contract_clarifications.resolution: Separate oracle-admission rejection from required real API invalid_request behavior. Only admitted workflow inputs receive product verdicts through that oracle; malformed API tests use actual interface adapters.

contract_clarifications.issue: Sequential output agreement does not establish atomic fencing at the write boundary.
contract_clarifications.resolution: Use bounded interposition at required public Store.start_job/fail_job operations or declared transaction observations, second connection state change, then release. Avoid private-helper requirements or scheduler-dependent race success.

contract_clarifications.issue: The clean textual merge conflict/repair requirement must not reward or require a correct live trajectory to manufacture a defect.
contract_clarifications.resolution: Freeze as harness qualification using authored disjoint control with verified before/after public results, reviewers and ancestry; report natural model integration errors separately.

contract_clarifications.issue: Malformed transport combinations and multiple simultaneous invalid conditions may lack an explicit precedence rule.
contract_clarifications.resolution: Use one decisive invalid class at a time. If exact precedence/framing behavior is required, publish it prospectively before grading; do not infer private requirements.

consumer_boundary.product_registry_rule: Every product gate binding.subject must equal the evaluated final product subject, including environment/dependencies, architecture, storage audit, workflow adapter and integration provenance. Never substitute the evaluator or control fixture tree for the candidate source.
consumer_boundary.qualification_prerequisite_rule: A separately verified admission step must authenticate required harness-control, oracle-admission and scope prerequisites with exact evaluator/protocol/runtime/contract lineage before invoking the product registry. Their different qualification subject is explicit and never relabeled as candidate execution.
consumer_boundary.mixed_clause_rule: V0-ADAPTER-01, V0-ADAPTER-02 and M1-ADAPTER-03 declare candidate behavior in required_gate_ids and evaluator/oracle admission in required_prerequisite_gate_ids=[M1-GATE-ADMISSION], identically on each row and mapping. Other rows explicitly declare an empty required_prerequisite_gate_ids list. Prerequisite requirement rows retain their own qualification gates in required_gate_ids. Combined row acceptance requires both disjoint declared lists; candidate and qualification subjects remain distinct.
consumer_boundary.combined_acceptance_rule: A product Registry pass is necessary but does not establish combined row or M1 acceptance until every declared required_prerequisite_gate_ids dependency and global prerequisite requirement qualifies with authenticated lineage. Feed only product required_gate_ids to the generic product Registry. The admission layer must verify and retain prerequisite results separately; never insert a qualification observation with a different subject into the product Registry.
consumer_boundary.public_purpose_compatibility: Product gates use public_development, public_contract_regression and source_bound_qualification, all unsupported by the current generic Registry closed purpose vocabulary. These literal identities are preserved; none is implicitly equivalent to public_release or another supported purpose. The consuming adapters or next contract must define and qualify an authoritative purpose mapping before activation. Such a mapping must preserve original observation purpose and exact bindings; it cannot relabel retained evidence. Consumer mapping remains unimplemented.
required_before_consumption: Implement and qualify the inventory-to-registry adapter with an explicit product/prerequisite partition.
Freeze exact ordered checks and check-to-requirement mappings for every gate.

Freeze and qualify an authoritative mapping for every unsupported product gate purpose (public_development, public_contract_regression, source_bound_qualification), preserving original observation identities and bindings without relabeling evidence.
Verify complete prerequisite lineage, final candidate bindings and existing release/freeze barriers.
consumer_boundary.dependency_structure: For every row and corresponding requirement_gate_mappings entry, required_gate_ids and required_prerequisite_gate_ids must match and be disjoint. Gate requirement_ids is exactly the inverse membership of their union. Validate gate categories as well as names; inverse membership alone does not create a required dependency.
